text_block_list.text:
A beach bathed in sunlight... What a
perfect
setting for the prelude of the
battle to determine
the strongest
generation!
text_block_list.name: Legendary Bard

text_block_list.text:
Yes, the heroes of the Golden
Generation are
taking part in this very
camp, and I am destined
to overthrow
them!
text_block_list.name: Legendary Bard

text_block_list.text:
Onward, Opera O opera troupe! We
shall prevail
in this water dousing
skirmish and simultaneously
bolster our
own forces!
text_block_list.name: Legendary Bard
